1.w: And God blessed Noah and his sons and said to them, “Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth.

2.w: And the fear of you⁺ and the dread of you⁺ shall be on every beast of the earth, and on every bird of the heavens, on all that moves [on] the earth, and on all the fish of the sea. Into your⁺ hand they are given—

3.w: every moving thing that [has in] it life, for you⁺ it shall be for food; as the green plants, I have given to you⁺ everything.

4.w: But flesh with its life—its blood—you⁺ shall not eat.

5.w: And surely your⁺ blood for your⁺ lives I will require; from the hand of every beast I will require it, and from the hand of the man; from the hand of each man’s brother I will require [for] the life of the man.

6.w: Whoever sheds the blood of the man, by the man his blood shall be shed; for in the image of God He has made the man.

7.w: And you⁺, be fruitful and multiply; swarm on the earth and multiply on it.”

8.w: And God said to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

9.w: “And I—behold, I, am establishing My covenant with you⁺ and with your⁺ seed after you⁺,

10.w: and with every living creature that [is] with you⁺, among the bird, among the livestock, and among every beast of the earth with you⁺, from all those going out of the ark, to every beast of the earth.

11.w: And I have establishd My covenant with you⁺, that all flesh shall never again be cut off by the waters of the flood; and there shall never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

12.w: And God said, “This [is] the sign of the covenant that I am giving between Me, and between you⁺, and between every living soul that [is] with you⁺, for generations everlasting.

13.w: My bow I have set in the cloud, and it shall be for [a] sign of the covenant between Me and between the earth.

14.w: And it shall come to pass in My bringing a cloud over the earth, that the bow shall be seen in the cloud.

15.w: And I will remember My covenant, that [is] between Me, and between you⁺, and between every living creature of all flesh; and the waters shall never again become a flood to destroy all flesh.

16.w: And the bow shall be in the cloud, and I will look on it to remember the everlasting covenant between God and between every living soul of all flesh that [is] on the earth.”

17.w: And God said to Noah, “This [is] the sign of the covenant that I have established between Me and between all flesh that [is] on the earth.”

18.w: And the sons of Noah who went out from the ark were Shem and Ham and Japheth. And Ham—he [was] the father of Canaan.

19.w: These [were] the three sons of Noah, and from these all the earth was scattered.

20.w: And Noah began [to be] a man of the ground, and he planted a vineyard.

21.w: And he drank from the wine and became drunk, and uncovered himself in the midst of his tent.

22.w: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and he told his two brothers outside.

23.w: And Shem took—and Japheth—the garment, and they laid [it] on the shoulders of the two of them and they went backward and covered the nakedness of their father. And their faces [were] backward, and the nakedness of their father they did not see.

24.w: And Noah awoke from his wine and he knew what his youngest son had done to him.

25.w: And he said, “Cursed [be] Canaan! A servant of servants he shall be to his brothers.”

26.w: And he said, “Blessed [be] YHWH, the God of Shem! And may Canaan be a servant to him.

27.w: May God enlarge Japheth, and may he dwell in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be a servant to them.”

28.w: And after the flood Noah lived three hundred years and fifty years.

29.w: And all the days of Noah were nine hundred years and fifty years, and he died.
